meta.source: Foreplay clone at /foreplay (React+Vite), derived from design-repo/templates + sections, which record src/ as built. Mirrors https://www.foreplay.co sitemap.

redirects.note: /apac-demo is not specced; the book-demo APAC bar links here

meta.notes: Long copy outside the homepage is stand-in text; third-party embeds are placeholders; navbar/footer carry no outbound links.

categories.SHELL: Global chrome mounted once in src/App.jsx on every route (navbar, footer, overlays).
categories.NAV: In-page navigation aids (breadcrumbs, tables of contents) that are not the global navbar.
categories.HERO: The opening block of a page: title, intro copy, primary actions and hero media.
categories.CONTENT: Body blocks that explain products, list CMS entries, or carry article/rich-text content.
categories.SOCIAL-PROOF: Reviews, testimonials, logo walls and ratings.
categories.PRICING: Plan cards, pricing comparisons and plan-feature tables.
categories.INTERACTIVE: Blocks whose main job is a behaviour: tabs, carousels, accordions, filters.
categories.FORM: Lead / application / signup forms (render fields, never submit).
categories.CONVERSION: Closing calls to action that push to trial or demo.
categories.OVERLAY: Fixed or modal UI layered above the page.
